eligibility: finite certifiedSupportFloorZ from the original GridMap snapshot
original measured source ns > 0; existing measuredBodyYaw source-age/frame/position gate passes before selection
both incoming solver velocity and original worker measured velocity finite, complete XYZ std::hypot norm <= 0.03 m/s
incoming acceleration finite and every component exactly zero; nonzero values including 1e-300 preserve old boundary
effect: Only local-by-value solver initial velocity/acceleration become zero. Original raw body pose, raw velocity/source and current adoption witness remain unchanged. This is curve selection inside the existing 0.05 m/s C1 tolerance, not a stationary certificate or permission.
unchanged: future original XYZ reference including Z
manager.max_vel / max_acc, command max speed / yaw / ramp
candidate_adoption measured velocity/source and .05 C1 checks
TaggedBspline join_twist remains original measured velocity; acceleration_valid remains the old source value, with no invented C2 evidence
full-curve collision and map/body source gates
moving vs stationary writer CAS, motion sweep, stop and execution leases
actual measured progress and owner route credits

tests.build: existing isolated scan_planner CMake offline test target, --parallel 1; no node/install/ROS/Kit

meaningful_regressions: full-XYZ low boundary chooses zero without mutating inputs
disabled / non-guided / absent or nonfinite floor preserves old boundary
missing or negative original source denies fitting
either full XYZ norm above .03 denies, including low XY / high Z
exact .03 eligible, next floating value above .03 denied, no minimum speed introduced
every nonzero incoming acceleration including a subnormal-scale value retains exact old boundary
nonfinite data never converted to plausible zero
real fixed-boundary 3D cubic preserves original start Z .481 and future Z .52; original native adoption returns raw vz .007 and original ns, acceleration_valid=false
latest raw velocity .051 rejected by original .05 C1 guard
whole-curve collision rejection and a one-nanosecond final source change each deny adoption
limitations: This implementation makes no claim that low measured velocity proves rest.
It does not repair high-speed gait / XYZ derivative .15 contract incompatibility; norm > .03 uses the old exact boundary.
No formal v34 result, continuous navigation success or physical acceptance is claimed by these offline tests.
